summary.headline: China calls Amodei slowdown essay 'fearmongering'; coordination dips
summary.body: A light day. China's Foreign Ministry dismissed Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's essay urging a paced frontier and continued US chip curbs as 'fearmongering'. That is a small knock to Global Coordination, which trims Gatekeeper and nudges Self-Destruction up. Separately, 404 Media reported that contractors read real ChatGPT conversations under 'Project Lily', adding to Surveillance & Control and edging up 1984. Benevolent Dictator slipped just ahead of Descendants. Horizon Balance: -6.79.
summary.movers_note: Gatekeeper -0.1 and Self-Destruction +0.1 followed China's rebuke of Amodei (-0.14 and +0.10); 1984 +0.1 came from the Project Lily report (+0.13), partly offset by the China story (-0.08).

events.title: China rebukes Amodei's chip-control slowdown essay as 'fearmongering'
events.summary: China's Foreign Ministry called Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's essay urging a paced frontier and continued US chip curbs 'fearmongering', saying confrontation disrupts global AI governance.
events.reason: Official dismissal in a US-China AI governance dispute.

events.title: Report: hundreds of contractors read real ChatGPT conversations under 'Project Lily'
events.summary: 404 Media reported that contractors hired via Crossing Hurdles and paid through Mercor review real ChatGPT conversations that can contain sensitive personal details; OpenAI says identifiers are stripped.
events.reason: Privacy exposure of user data at scale.
